response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(sp.procgpu * 1.0 / sp.proccpu) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per run as procgpu*1.0/proccpu (real division). Runs with a NULL or zero proccpu give a NULL ratio, so AVG skips them.
Only runs whose zoneref matches a row in sites are kept (inner join). Sites with a NULL entrystat form their own group.
